caption: Every time a customer has to wait for you to check your calendar, there's a chance they book someone else. If booking was something customers could just do, while you're on the job or asleep, how much easier would your week be?

slides.headline: Your calendar is costing you customers
Someone wants to book a time.
slides.body: You're on a job. The message waits until you can check your diary.

slides.headline: Then the back and forth starts.
slides.body: Does Tuesday work? What about Thursday? Hours pass between every reply.

slides.headline: Meanwhile, they're asking someone else.
slides.body: The business that locks in a time first usually gets the job.

slides.headline: What if booking looked after itself?
slides.body: Your agent offers free times, confirms one and adds it to your calendar.

slides.headline: Same customer. Different week.
slides.body: They're booked in, you're still on the job, and nobody played phone tag.

beats.bubble: I have Tuesday 10am or Thursday 2pm free. Which suits you?
